name: web-app-sdk
description: Agents, skills, hooks, and architecture rules for building full-stack TypeScript web apps on a shared monorepo stack: Turborepo + pnpm, Next.js App Router, Hono + tRPC + Zod, an MCP server, AI agents, and Supabase (Postgres + RLS). Enforces a service-layer-first workflow and keeps docs in sync.
